body.message:
We would like to inform you that your check-out is scheduled for today.

If you wish to extend your stay until 1st August, we would be happy to arrange it. The extension rate for 3 nights is AED 715.20.

Kindly confirm if you would like to proceed with the extension. Once we receive your confirmation, we will send you the payment link to complete the payment and finalize your booking extension.
